_comment: Slag Rubble: the Nether's Stone Rubble, and it does the same job (owner, 2026-08-19).
Sift a shard out, put four together, get the terrain block back - the exact shape
rubble_pulls and stone_from_shards already use in the demolition yard.
This is the ONLY source of Nether terrain in the game: the compacted depths generate no
netherrack, no basalt and no soul sand, so every block of it is rebuilt from shards. That is
what makes the dimension worth mining rather than a place you pass through.
Weights mirror rubble_pulls' shape - the common ground leads, the specials trail. Final
numbers belong to the balance pass (#36).
MAGMA IS NOT HERE (owner, 2026-08-19): it moved to techno-organic waste. Slag Rubble is the
fraction that never fused and has finished cooling - burnt, glassy, cold. Magma has not finished
cooling, so it belongs in the mass that is still hot rather than in the spoil beside it.
NYLIUM comes from the rubble too (owner, 2026-08-19), and it is the most load-bearing thing in this
table. Nylium is terrain - netherrack with a fungal crust - so it belongs here on the same grounds
as the rest. What makes it matter more than the others is what vanilla does with it: bone meal on
nylium grows roots and fungus, and a fungus bone-mealed on its own nylium becomes a HUGE fungus,
which is stems, shroomlight and weeping vines. The depths grow no fungus forest, so this is the
only seed for one - and the whole crimson and warped family hangs off it.
SKY STONE, the rarest thing in the stream, through a nested table so it can be
conditioned on AE2 - see gameplay/sky_stone_finds.json. Weight 15 of 405 (3.7%)
against a previous floor of 30. Demand is bounded and front-loaded: 16 shards per
Controller block and 16 per 256k cell, so 50 to 150 for a whole playthrough.
